title: Individuals & Societies — Urbanisation Source Paper
subject: Individuals & Societies
instructions:
Answer **all** questions.

This paper is based on two sources. Each source is shown above the questions that use it. Refer to the sources by their labels in your answers.

contexts.label: Source A
contexts.title: Extract from a city planning report (fictional), 2024
contexts.text:
Between 2000 and 2020 the population of Riverton grew from 1.2 million to 2.1 million. Most of this growth came from **rural–urban migration**: young adults moved to the city in search of factory and service jobs.

The city council could not build housing fast enough. By 2020 an estimated 35% of residents lived in informal settlements on the eastern floodplain, where homes lack piped water and are at risk during the rainy season.

> "We came for work, and there is work. But the rent in the centre is impossible, so we built here." — resident of the eastern settlements

contexts.label: Source B
contexts.title: Riverton population and services, 2000–2020
contexts.text:
| Year | Population (millions) | Homes with piped water (%) | Average commute (minutes) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| 2000 | 1.2 | 81 | 24 |
| 2005 | 1.4 | 78 | 27 |
| 2010 | 1.6 | 72 | 33 |
| 2015 | 1.9 | 66 | 41 |
| 2020 | 2.1 | 61 | 48 |

Percentage change is calculated as $\dfrac{\text{new} - \text{old}}{\text{old}} \times 100$.

questions.text: Using Source A, what was the main cause of Riverton's population growth between 2000 and 2020?
Using Source A, describe **two** problems faced by people living in the eastern settlements.
Using Source A and your own knowledge, explain why many migrants live in informal settlements rather than in the city centre.

parts.label: a
parts.text: Calculate the percentage change in Riverton's population from 2000 to 2020. Show your working.

parts.label: b
parts.text: Between 2000 and 2020 the share of homes with piped water fell by {{1}} percentage points, while the average commute rose by {{2}} minutes.

parts.label: c
parts.text: Describe the relationship between population size and access to piped water shown in Source B.

questions.text: Using Sources A and B, evaluate **one** strategy Riverton's council could use to manage the effects of rapid urban growth.
